title: What They Believe
subtitle: Blood is the most fundamental truth
text: The Harbingers do not worship a blood god. There is no deity at the center of their faith. Blood is simply the carrier of life, memory, and identity. To master it is to master the most fundamental truth of being alive. They believe it would be sacrilegious and wasteful not to use and share what flows within them. They are not evil. They are shunned, taboo, misunderstood — the way anything unfamiliar and vaguely body-horror-adjacent tends to be.
